name: Iconify
description: Icon set usable for hash/keyword/embedding/LLM-chosen glyph on a coloured tile: pick an icon by metadata, draw its SVG on a palette background.

restrictions: Framework MIT but ~200 icon sets each with own licence (some CC BY, GPL): filter by set licence

bundleSize.source: per-icon ~0.3-1 kB gz (estimate); full set not bundled

cost.notes: Import individual icons to avoid bundling the full set.

verdictReason: Largest catalogue, so it needs a licence-filtered allow-list; wrap later.
